strengths: Clear quiet-editorial hospitality point of view instead of generic SaaS UI.
Strong asymmetric composition and page energy curve with a deliberate dark focal section.
Mobile is recomposed rather than merely scaled and preserves fast task access via a bottom dock.
Motion is restrained and native; interaction does not depend on animation to remain usable.
The guide interaction and Today panel now have meaningful functional states rather than decorative controls.
top_root_causes_blocking_92: Imagery is intentionally abstract and CSS-generated; it does not yet carry enough real hospitality/place specificity for an exceptional art-direction score.
The signature interaction is useful but not yet memorable enough to become a proprietary brand behavior.

Micro labels and utility typography are highly editorial but approach the lower edge of comfortable real-device legibility; final production would need native-device inspection and content stress tests.
next_countermeasures: Introduce one project-specific photographic or spatial asset system, not a generic stock-image layer.
Turn one real guest task—arrival path, room control, or neighborhood curation—into the single signature interaction.
Run real-device typography review and field/lab Core Web Vitals after deployment before release.
note: The score is intentionally below the OS release threshold. The experiment demonstrates that the critic is allowed to reject a visually strong build rather than inflating the score to validate the system.
